#### **Overview**

This project focused on analyzing Google Analytics 4 reports to identify trends in website traffic, user engagement, and marketing performance. By comparing key metrics and interpreting dashboard reports, I developed recommendations to improve digital marketing performance and enhance the user experience.

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

#### **Learning Outcomes**

- Interpret Google Analytics 4 reports and dashboards.
- Analyze website traffic and user engagement.
- Compare marketing performance across different metrics.
- Develop data-driven marketing recommendations.
- Communicate findings through visual reports.

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

#### **Key Skills Gained**

- Google Analytics 4
- Marketing Reporting
- KPI Analysis
- Data Interpretation
- Digital Marketing Analytics
- Business Communication
